query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "video-oasis: rethinking evaluation of video understanding" computer science
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (a) and (b) as it provides a canonical benchmark and empirical evaluation for the specific domain of video understanding in Multimodal LLMs, directly addressing the "Video-Oasis" context of rethinking evaluation metrics and capabilities for this mechanism. It establishes the necessary baseline and alternative vocabulary (multi-turn dialogue evaluation) that a literature review on extending video understanding evaluation would require.
